rationale: DeCo is the direct training-free multimodal precedent and DoLa is its contrastive comparator; this learned head is retained only as a controlled extension if their pilot is informative.
measurement_concept: attribute-conditioned patch pooling followed by attention over stage summaries

split_policy.official_test: single evaluation after every architecture and spatial choice is locked

uncertainty: paired image-cluster bootstrap over predictions; report all three training seeds

spatial_scale_sweep.control_policy: match token count, bird-box membership, and hidden-state norm distribution exactly
spatial_scale_sweep.selection_rule: lock one spatial scale on development validation before official-test access

required: positive paired improvement over the strongest simple baseline
direction agrees across all three seeds
leave-one-attribute and leave-one-species conclusions remain stable
attention weights are finite, normalized, and non-degenerate
promotion_gate.if_gate_fails: retain as a negative exploratory result and do not spend official-test budget

claim_boundary: A successful frozen-feature head shows improved decodability or prediction from combined stages. It does not prove that the unmodified VLM naturally uses the learned fusion path.
